limits: Single sequential local pair; sampled lower bounds; peak sampled CPU cores uses subsecond deltas and is noisy. Compiler-limited state can coincide with no available workers. No historical pass pooling.

metrics.workerTimeDefinition: Serial executed task elapsed time, including waits and cleanup; not CPU time or bootstrap steps
metrics.observationScope: Node child_process launches under inherited preload; lower bounds. Shell launches, native custom-promisified calls and consumers that clear NODE_OPTIONS are excluded. Counts include failed attempts.
metrics.resourceLimit: Whole-worker CPU and simultaneous process-tree RSS are not measured by this portable observer

processTree.scope: Linux /proc snapshots of controller and observed descendants, including detached children and known surviving identities; sampler excluded
processTree.limits: Sampled lower bounds: short-lived processes, exit CPU tails and unseen reparenting can be missed. RSS sums include shared pages in each process; not unique physical or cgroup memory. Idle/wait states are sampled report observations, not compiler CPU or precise admission events.
